_comment: A boss's sequence goes on (docs/gameplay/25_BOSS_GAUNTLET.md; rounds of 1, 2, 4 since 2026-11-28, docs/gameplay/27 §3.3): its first round (a bat alone) beaten, there is no result screen: the 3D stage travels on and the second round starts by itself, two together (a slime leading, a bat beside it); then four; the boss is last.
